title.zh: 【马来西亚央行推出 SSDS+ 平台，支持代币化债券与伊斯兰债券发行】
title.en: 【马来西亚央行推出 SSDS+ 平台，支持代币化债券与伊斯兰债券发行】

current_state.zh: Bank Negara Malaysia launched SSDS+, a distributed-ledger-based securities depository supporting issuance, custody and transfer of tokenized debt securities including sukuk, with settlement in central bank money through integration with the RENTAS+ real-time funds and securities transfer system.
current_state.en: Bank Negara Malaysia launched SSDS+, a distributed-ledger-based securities depository supporting issuance, custody and transfer of tokenized debt securities including sukuk, with settlement in central bank money through integration with the RENTAS+ real-time funds and securities transfer system.
